issues.title: Daily streak counter
issues.body:
## Goal
Show how many days in a row the player has finished at least one game.

## Why it matters
Streaks bring players back tomorrow.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Home screen shows the current streak as a number with a flame icon
- [ ] Playing a game today keeps the streak; missing a whole day resets it to 0
- [ ] The streak survives an app restart

## Out of scope
Reminder notifications and streak freezes.

issues.title: Hint button that reveals the continent
issues.body:
## Goal
Add a Hint button on the clue screen that reveals which continent the country is in.

## Why it matters
Stuck players get a nudge instead of quitting.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Hint button appears under the clues
- [ ] Tapping it shows the continent name once per round
- [ ] Using a hint lowers the points for that round

## Out of scope
Hints for flag rounds.

issues.title: Haptic buzz on a correct guess
issues.body:
## Goal
Give a short vibration when the player picks the right answer.

## Why it matters
Makes correct answers feel rewarding.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Correct answer triggers a light haptic on Android and iOS
- [ ] Wrong answers do not vibrate
- [ ] Respects the system haptics setting

## Out of scope
A settings toggle (separate ticket).

issues.title: Share my passport
issues.body:
## Goal
Let the player share an image of their passport stamps from the Passport screen.

## Why it matters
Sharing is free marketing and a nice flex.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Share button on the Passport screen
- [ ] Opens the native share sheet with a PNG of the stamps
- [ ] Works on both Android and iOS

## Out of scope
Sharing individual stamps.

issues.title: Zoomable flag
issues.body:
## Goal
Allow pinch-to-zoom on the flag in flag rounds.

## Why it matters
Small details like emblems are hard to see on a phone.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Pinch zooms the flag up to 3x
- [ ] Double-tap resets the zoom
- [ ] Zoom resets between rounds

## Out of scope
Panning beyond the flag bounds.

issues.title: Sound on/off toggle
issues.body:
## Goal
Add a switch in the top bar to mute game sounds.

## Why it matters
Players often play in quiet places.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Toggle visible on the Home screen
- [ ] Choice is remembered after restart
- [ ] Muted state silences all game sounds

## Out of scope
Volume slider.

3.author: factory-bot
3.body:
<!-- factory:plan -->
## Approach
Add a small `Haptics` expect/actual in the shared module. Android uses `Vibrator`/`HapticFeedback`, iOS uses `UIImpactFeedbackGenerator`. Call it when an answer is confirmed correct.

## Files
- `shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/me/vladcip/guessthecountry/ui/GameScreen.kt`
- `shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/me/vladcip/guessthecountry/designsystem/components/AnswerOption.kt`
- `shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/me/vladcip/guessthecountry/domain/game/Game.kt`

## Tests
Unit test that a correct answer emits the haptic event and a wrong one does not.

## Risks
Haptics differ per device; keep the intensity light.

3.author: factory-bot
3.body:
<!-- factory:plan-review -->
Plan looks sound. Make sure the haptic is fired from the UI layer, not the domain `Game`, so tests stay pure. Otherwise approved.

4.body:

## Approach
Render the stamp grid to a bitmap off-screen and hand it to the platform share sheet through an expect/actual `ShareImage`.

## Files

4.author: factory-bot
4.body:
<!-- factory:plan-review -->
Approach is fine. Keep image size bounded so large passports do not run out of memory.

5.author: factory-bot
5.body:
<!-- factory:plan -->
## Approach
Wrap the flag image in a `transformable` modifier holding scale state, clamp to 1x-3x, and reset on double-tap and when the round changes.

## Files
- `shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/me/vladcip/guessthecountry/designsystem/components/Chips.kt`
- `shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/me/vladcip/guessthecountry/domain/game/FlagRound.kt`
- `shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/me/vladcip/guessthecountry/ui/GameScreen.kt`

## Tests
Test the clamp logic in a pure helper (scale in, scale out).

## Risks
Gesture conflicts with scrolling.

5.author: factory-bot
5.body:
<!-- factory:plan-review -->
Good. Extract the clamp so it can be tested without Compose.

## Approach

## Files

## Risks
